tweets.text:
Three cylinders. Three exhausts. One very serious hatchback.

2024 Toyota GR Corolla Circuit Edition.
300 hp from 1.6 litres is 187 hp per litre — specific output usually reserved for engines with twice the cylinder count.
The centre exhaust is a working outlet, not a trim panel with a hole in it.
GR-FOUR all-wheel drive comes from the same programme Toyota goes rallying with.
Six-speed manual, and no automatic offered at any price.
The numbers: 300 hp · 273 lb-ft · 1.6 L turbo I3 · 0–60 mph in 4.9 sec · AWD GR-FOUR · 6 spd manual.
It's the most interesting car Toyota sells, and the one nobody cross-shops.

Would you take 300 hp from three cylinders over 300 hp from four?

#GRCorolla #HotHatch
